digest.en: Middle East & Africa leads the board this hour with Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर यूरोप और रूस की अगुवाई है, अगर इस पूरे साल बंद रहा होर्मुज स्ट्रेट तो इन देशों हालात हो जाएंगे खस्ता, जानें लिस्ट में कौन-कौन? मुख्य खबर है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Ebola en RDC, une épidémie hors de contrôle ?
articles.summary: Dans cet épisode d’Afrique 360°, Enrica Picco et Rinaldo Depagne reçoivent Frédéric Manantsoa Lai, coordinateur des urgences pour Médecins Sans Frontières, et Onesphore Sematumba, analyste senior pour la République démocratique du Congo et le Burundi à Crisis Group, pour parler de l’épidémie d’Ebola en RDC et de ses conséquences sur la population congolaise, déjà marquée par des années de conflit.

articles.title: Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?
articles.summary: İkinci Dünya Savaşı sonrasında şekillenen uluslararası düzen giderek çözülürken, Ankara ve diğer Avrupa başkentlerindeki yetkililer güvenlik alanında birlikte hareket etmedikleri takdirde ciddi risklerle karşı karşıya kalacaklarının giderek daha fazla farkına varıyor. Tehdit algıları farklılık gösterse de, pragmatik ve esnek iş birliği yolları geliştirmeleri hâlâ mümkün. Avrupa Birliği ve Türkiye: Savunmada Birlik?

articles.title: Ukraine Hits Another Wildberries Hub, This Time In Russia's Vladimir Region
articles.summary: Ukraine has launched another drone strike targeting a Wildberries warehouse overnight on August 3, according to Russian authorities. The attack in the Vladimir region is part of a broader campaign in recent weeks that has repeatedly hit the logistics network of Russia's largest online retailer. Ukraine Hits Another Wildberries Hub, This Time In Russia's Vladimir Region.

articles.title: Russian Logistics Sites Targeted Again As Zelenskyy Urges Faster Patriot Deliveries
articles.summary: Ukraine and Russia exchanged another wave of overnight drone strikes targeting logistics, energy, and civilian infrastructure, as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy voiced frustration with Western allies over delays in delivering urgently needed Patriot air defense systems and other military aid. Russian Logistics Sites Targeted Again As Zelenskyy Urges Faster Patriot Deliveries.

Business live – latest updatesThe yen has hit its highest level in three months after Japan and the US launched a combined operation to support the Japanese currency. Yen hits three-month high after Trump helps prop up currency.

articles.summary: On Sunday, August 2, OPEC+ approved an oil production quota increase of around 188,000 barrels ⁠per day from September, the producer group said, in a move that ⁠completes the unwinding of a layer of voluntary output cuts. Oil prices tumble as Trump cancels attack on Iran to reach nuclear deal.

articles.title: Chaos of border crossing gives way to limbo for Moroccans on Ceuta’s streets
articles.summary: People among the more than 50,000 who entered Spanish enclave this week describe the journey and their prospectsFour days ago, Youssef El Abbas saw an opportunity to reclaim the life he had lost seven years earlier. News was circulating that about 400 people had swum from Morocco to the neighbouring Spanish enclave of Ceuta on the north African coast, approximately 12 miles (19km) across the strai.

articles.title: Trapped by a Facebook job advert, freed by a stranger in a taxi
articles.summary: Sofia* was 27, raising her seven-year-old son alone in Venezuela, and running out of options. For years she had distributed personal hygiene products door to door, but as her customers’ finances collapsed, so did her income. Trapped by a Facebook job advert, freed by a stranger in a taxi.

articles.title: At Least 3 Killed, 21 Wounded In Moscow Restaurant Bombing, Russian Authorities Say
articles.summary: Russian authorities said on August 2 that an improvised explosive device was detonated at a restaurant in central Moscow, killing three people and wounding 21 others, as investigators worked to determine who was behind the bombing. 3 Killed, 21 Wounded In Moscow Restaurant Bombing, Russian Authorities Say.

articles.title: For These Ukrainian Soldiers, Accepting Death Proved The Key To Living
articles.summary: When Serhiy Kutrakov decided to take up arms in 2014 to defend Ukraine from Russian-backed separatists, he accepted he would likely be killed in combat. Documentarian Yulia Hontaruk followed Kutrakov and two other soldiers on and off the battlefield for 12 years. For These Ukrainian Soldiers, Accepting Death Proved The Key To Living.

articles.title: Trump Says He Called Off Impending Attack On Iran, Insists Deal Is Close
articles.summary: Trump said he has decided to hold off on new attacks on Iran, claiming the perimeters of a deal have been agreed with Tehran and that Israel is joining the US President Donald Trump said he has decided to "hold off" on any new attacks on Iran, saying "the perimeters" of a deal have been agreed to with Tehran and adding that Israel was joining him in the commitment.

articles.title: Anti-LGBTQ+ laws are on the rise across west Africa, campaigners warn
articles.summary: Activists in the region say politicians regard LGBTQ+ people as ‘the easiest scapegoats to maintain their power’A growing number of west African countries are implementing or strengthening anti-LGBTQ+ laws, amid local political pressures and a global pushback against LGBTQ+ rights. In March, Senegal doubled the maximum prison sentence for gay sex to 10 years and criminalised the “promotion” of homo Anti-LGBTQ+ laws are on the rise across west Africa, campaigners warn.

articles.title: Tourist plane crashes during flight over Peru’s Nazca Lines, killing 13
articles.summary: Aircraft crashes into field after departing from the nearby city of Ica, according to local authoritiesAt least 13 people have died after a plane carrying tourists crashed into a field in Peru, local authorities said. Aircraft crashes into field after departing from the nearby city of Pisco, according to local authorities At least 13 people, among them foreign tourists, have been killed in a plane crash in southern Peru, near the Nazca Lines, police reported on Saturday. Local authorities in Nazca confirmed that 11 tourists and two pilots died when the Cessna Grand Caravan crashed in Pueblo Viejo, approximately.

articles.title: Zelenskyy Says 'Answers' Needed On Patriot Delivery As Civilian Death Toll Climbs
articles.summary: In the wake of the latest deadly Russian air strikes on Kyiv and other cities, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy expressed frustration with his Western allies, urging speedier delivery of urgently needed Patriot air defense missiles and other weapons. Zelenskyy Expresses Frustration With Pace Of Patriot Deliveries As Civilian Death Toll Climbs. Zelenskyy Says 'Answers' Needed On Patriot Delivery As Civilian Death Toll Climbs.

articles.title: Russia Launches Deadly Ballistic Missile Attack On Kyiv
articles.summary: Russia launched dozens of ballistic missiles at Kyiv, killing at least nine people and injuring 23, according to emergency services. Zelenskyy said a shortage of air defense missiles limited Ukraine's ability to intercept the attack. Russia Launches Deadly Ballistic Missile Attack On Kyiv.

articles.title: Biggest Clue In US-Iran Conflict Is 'The Dog That Hasn't Barked,' Says War College's Jacob Stoil
articles.summary: A renewed exchange of military strikes and threats between the US and Iran has raised fresh fears of a wider Middle East war. But Jacob Stoil, research professor of Middle East security studies at the US Army War College, argues the more important story may be what has not happened. Biggest Clue In US-Iran Conflict Is 'The Dog That Hasn't Barked,' Says War College's Jacob Stoil.

articles.title: 10-Year-Old Ukrainian Gymnast Wins Gold After Losing Leg In Russian Strike
articles.summary: In 2022, Oleksandra Paskal lost her leg following a Russian missile strike on Ukraine’s Odesa region. She was just six years old. Following months of intense rehabilitation, she learned to walk with a prosthesis -- and made a remarkable return to rhythmic gymnastics. 10-Year-Old Ukrainian Gymnast Wins Gold After Losing Leg In Russian Strike.

articles.title: Patriot Debate Deepens As Congressman Don Bacon Questions Trump Shift, Senate Moves On Ukraine Arms
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump's decision to step back from his earlier pledge to allow Ukraine to manufacture Patriot missile interceptors has prompted renewed debate in Washington over the future direction of US military support for Kyiv. Patriot Debate Deepens As Bacon Questions Trump Shift, Senate Moves On Ukraine Arms. Patriot Debate Deepens As Don Bacon Questions Trump Shift, Senate Moves On Ukraine Arms.

articles.title: India’s environmental crisis undermines its great-power ambitions
articles.summary: India wants to become the world’s next manufacturing superpower and an indispensable leader of the Global South. It seeks to attract global supply chains relocating from China, expand high-technology manufacturing, become a hub for artificial intelligence and semiconductor industries and strengthen its influence in global climate diplomacy. Yet one of the greatest obstacles to these [] The post I India’s environmental crisis undermines its great-power ambitions.

articles.title: Russia Pounds Kyiv With Ballistic Missiles As Ukraine Struggles With Air Defense Shortages
articles.summary: Russia targeted the Ukrainian capital with ballistic missiles early on August 1 as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy pressed for the Washington to grant licenses for Kyiv to produce its own Patriot air defense missiles amid apparent renewed reluctance by US President Donald Trump. Russia Pounds Kyiv With Ballistic Missiles As Ukraine Struggles With Air Defense Shortages.

articles.title: Strong El Niño ahead, UN weather agency warns
articles.summary: As much of the world faces grapples with above normal temperatures and major rainfall changes, the UN Meteorological Organization (WMO) warned on Friday that El Niño, a powerful climate pattern shaping global weather, will intensify starting next month. Strong El Niño ahead, UN weather agency warns.

articles.title: Archbishop of Canterbury vows to support £100m pledge helping communities affected by enslavement

articles.title: अगर इस पूरे साल बंद रहा होर्मुज स्ट्रेट तो इन देशों हालात हो जाएंगे खस्ता, जानें लिस्ट में कौन-कौन?
articles.summary: अकाउंटिंग और कंसल्टिंग फर्म ईवाई ने दावा किया है कि अगर होर्मुज अगले साल तक बंद रहता है, तो 2027 में ब्रिटेन की अर्थव्यवस्था मंदी की चपेट में आ सकती है. ब्रिटेन में महंगाई फिर बढ़ सकती है, लोगों का खर्च कम हो सकता है. पहले से कमजोर आर्थिक सुधार की रफ्तार भी पटरी से उतर सकती है. इस बीच जानते हैं कि वो कौनसे देश हैं जिन पर अगले साल तक होर्मुज बंद रहने का सबसे ज्यादा असर होगा.

articles.summary: असम समेत भारत के कुछ राज्य बुरी तरह बाढ़ की चपेट में हैं. इसकी वजह से केरल में छह लोगों की मौत भी हो चुकी है. इस बीच असम सरकार ने अपने राज्य के प्रभावित लोगों की मदद के लिए बड़ा कदम उठाया है. असम की बीजेपी सरकार ने बाढ़ प्रभावित परिवारों के लिए सोमवार (3 अगस्त) को लगभग 75,000 रुपये प्रति परिवार की अंतरिम राहत की पहली किस्त जारी की.

articles.summary: पश्चिम बंगाल के मुख्यमंत्री शुभेंदु अधिकारी अब बुलेटप्रूफ गाड़ी से चलेंगे. पश्चिम बंगाल के मुख्यमंत्री शुभेंदु अधिकारी की सुरक्षा को लेकर अहम कदम उठाया गया है. वे अब बुलेटप्रूफ गाड़ी से चलेंगे. बंगाल सीएम ने आतंकवादी संगठन 'जैश-ए-मोहम्मद' से जान को खतरा होने की हालिया जानकारी के बाद यह कदम उटाया है. पश्चिम बंगाल पुलिस की स्पेशल टास्क फोर्स (एसटीएफ) से जुड़े सूत्रों ने दो संदिग्धों की गिरफ्तारियों के बाद इसको लेकर अहम जानकारी दी.
